lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A dense arrangement of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters is visible, forming semi-regular horizontal rows across the mid-flank. Due to significant backscatter noise, precise triangulation of individual centroids is limited, but the clusters follow a grid-like distribution relative to the gills.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of higher pixel intensity are observed intersecting the horizontal rows of blobs, creating a lattice-like visual structure, most prominent in the region posterior to the pectoral fin.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A primary linear ridge is visible horizontally along the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a distinct luminance gradient with higher pixel values on the dorsal aspect and lower, shadowed values on the ventral aspect.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple elongated, low-luminance silhouettes characteristic of commensal fish (Echeneidae) positioned ventrally to the main body mass.
